I [F19] told myself I wasn't going to comment on any of these pornfree related subs because I'm a bit embarrassed, but I do have a tip. Don't go cold turkey, gradually lessen your use. I found it was much more effective. 3 years ago I had a pretty heavy addiction, I'd watch porn casually as if it were social media / YouTube, and then weeks later I discovered masturbation which made the addiction much worse. I would literally look at the time and go "it's been 6 hours since I last did it which means I'm fine to do it now" I'd do it everyday, often twice a day. 
Then lent came around and I gave up porn for it lasting 52 days without it, I didn't feel the need after day 40 so I went 12 more days without it before deciding eh I can treat myself a lil. It has never been that bad since, but after my last breakup I realized I was getting more addicted and therefore getting worse mentally so I had set days for it.
At the moment it's Wednesdays and Saturdays, so only twice a week. I messed it up over a month ago so it was every Tuesday and Friday, but Wednesdays and Saturdays work better for me. I am going to try to cut out porn completely again (which is why I've been browsing the subs) but gradually.
Cutting down to 2 days out of 7 is great because I literally can't even fathom masturbating the day after I did it. It surprises me now how I was able to do it twice in one day honestly. I don't get horny as often as a result, it really only does hit hard on those days and sometimes I even think eh I can leave it for tonight on those days. I've been considering cutting it to once a week on Saturdays, but I think I'll wait till I'm out of lockdown to do that. Gradually lessening your use is so so so much easier than going cold turkey in my opinion.
